bio: Danielle Shariff is a PhD student in the Department of Political Science at Northeastern University.
Her ongoing research focuses on the fields of political discourse and social media, with a specific interest in the current U.S. political and civic information ecosystem.
Currently, Danielle is a Doctoral Research Assistant at the Defense Industrial Base Institute, an active member of the Society for Text & Discourse, and a Research Assistant for Dr. Sunny Yang.
